steps.desc: Offline narrow checks at unchanged reviewed fallback commit 7b51e521
steps.cmd: set -eu; cd /home/newton/work/dev-hermit/worktrees/slots/liteinst-syscall-fallback; raw=/home/newton/work/dev-hermit/ignored/liteinst-syscall-fallback-20260904; evidence=$raw/component-commit; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 7b51e521fcacbbe876c93d1cd0893c442c1a52f6; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; date -u +%FT%TZ > "$evidence/checks-started.txt"; sha256sum --check "$raw/review-freeze/source-files.sha256" > "$evidence/exact-head-source-before.log"; export CARGO_TARGET_DIR=$raw/target CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2; rustfmt --edition 2024 --check reverie-liteinst/src/lib.rs reverie-liteinst/src/runtime.rs reverie-liteinst/src/tool_host.rs reverie-liteinst/src/syscall_fallback.rs reverie-liteinst/src/bin/rpc_tool_guest.rs reverie-liteinst/src/bin/rpc_tool_guest/syscall_fallback.rs reverie-liteinst/tests/rpc_tool.rs > "$evidence/exact-head-format.log" 2>&1; cargo clippy --locked --offline -j2 -p reverie-liteinst --lib --bin reverie-liteinst-rpc-tool-guest --test rpc_tool -- -D warnings > "$evidence/exact-head-clippy.log" 2>&1; cargo test --locked --offline -j2 -p reverie-liteinst --test rpc_tool --no-run --message-format=json > "$evidence/rpc-build-artifacts.jsonl" 2> "$evidence/exact-head-rpc-build.log"; cargo test --locked --offline -j2 -p reverie-preload --no-default-features --features coordinator-rpc --lib --no-run --message-format=json > "$evidence/preload-build-artifacts.jsonl" 2> "$evidence/exact-head-preload-build.log"; jq -ers '[.[] | select(.reason == "compiler-artifact" and .target.name == "rpc_tool" and .executable != null) | .executable] | unique | if length == 1 then .[0] else error("expected one RPC test executable") end' "$evidence/rpc-build-artifacts.jsonl" > "$evidence/rpc-executable.txt"; jq -ers '[.[] | select(.reason == "compiler-artifact" and .target.name == "reverie_preload" and .executable != null) | .executable] | unique | if length == 1 then .[0] else error("expected one preload test executable") end' "$evidence/preload-build-artifacts.jsonl" > "$evidence/preload-executable.txt"; rpc=$(cat "$evidence/rpc-executable.txt"); preload=$(cat "$evidence/preload-executable.txt"); sha256sum "$rpc" "$preload" "$CARGO_TARGET_DIR/debug/reverie-liteinst-rpc-tool-guest" "$CARGO_TARGET_DIR/debug/deps/libreverie_liteinst.so" > "$evidence/exact-head-binaries.sha256"; ulimit -c 0; ulimit -f 65536; set +e; timeout --signal=KILL 60 "$rpc" --nocapture --test-threads=1 > "$evidence/exact-head-rpc-tests.log" 2>&1; rpc_status=$?; timeout --signal=KILL 60 "$preload" tool_host::tests:: --nocapture --test-threads=1 > "$evidence/exact-head-shared-driver-tests.log" 2>&1; preload_status=$?; printf '%s\n' "$rpc_status" > "$evidence/exact-head-rpc-tests.exit"; printf '%s\n' "$preload_status" > "$evidence/exact-head-shared-driver-tests.exit"; set -e; date -u +%FT%TZ > "$evidence/checks-ended.txt"; sha256sum --check "$raw/review-freeze/source-files.sha256" > "$evidence/exact-head-source-after.log"; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 7b51e521fcacbbe876c93d1cd0893c442c1a52f6; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; test "$rpc_status" -eq 0; test "$preload_status" -eq 0
